# Noobot v4.3.4

This release improves model caching, aligns native script capabilities with their documentation, fixes user interaction in child flows, upgrades third-party dependencies, optimizes the codebase, and resolves bugs.

- Fix model cache-hit behavior and provide configurable model cache fields.
- Align native script runtime capabilities with their documented behavior.
- Fix user interaction handling in child flows and their sessions.
- Upgrade third-party dependencies.
- Optimize protocol, runtime, plugin, and client code paths.
- Fix bugs affecting reliability and runtime consistency.
